locations.description: The Imlipur thana office, one room. Front doorway on the short wall, giving on a bare yard and the gate (the DSP's car in s2a02 is seen through this doorway). Inside, left to right: an empty, dusty complainants' bench by the door; the SHO's wooden desk with a paper cone of peanuts, a drift of shells and a black desk phone with a coiled cord; on the wall above it the ZERO-CRIME SHIELD (a wooden shield with a brass plate painted blank); a tall grey steel almirah with a padlock; at the back, the lockup, a barred door on a small bare cell with one bench, cobwebbed and unused. A wall clock with hands and no numerals. Slow ceiling fan. Day: flat warm daylight from the doorway. Night: one tube light. In s2a03 it is dressed for the press conference: a table with a cluster of microphones facing the camera, a blank cloth banner behind, no audience in frame. No flags, no national emblems, no portraits.

The lobby of the shut Roopam Talkies, fitted out as a police station. A terrazzo floor, two round pillars, faded empty film-poster frames on the walls (painted blank). Centre: Nirala's desk, the old booking counter, with registers squared in a stack, a rubber stamp, an ink pad, a kettle and two glasses; behind it a hand-painted board (painted blank; overlay). To one side: a complainants' bench and a nail with cardboard tokens on a string. To the other: the TICKET BOOTH, a small cubicle with an arched grille window, which is the lockup. A stair at the back goes up to the projection room. Day: dusty light from high windows. Night: one bare bulb over the desk. In the final image of branch B the same room has a new board over the desk (painted blank; overlay) and no tokens of rank anywhere.

The fake thana's malkhana, up the stair from the lobby. A narrow room. Steel racks that once held film cans now hold rows of sealed brown envelopes and cloth-tied files, each with a blank tag. The old projector stands under a dust sheet, its lens pointing at a small square port in the wall. One small window; afternoon light in shafts. A stool, a ledger on a shelf. The thickest file is tied in red cloth.

The railway level crossing that cuts Imlipur in two, with a tea stall beside it, halfway between the two thanas. A red-and-white striped gate arm, a single track running across frame, a signal lamp. The stall: a tin roof on bamboo poles, a bench, a blackened kettle on a coal stove, glasses, one hanging bulb. By day: Nandini's scooter waits at the lowered gate. By night: the bulb, the signal lamp and, in s2a01, the tail-lights of a loaded truck going away over the line. The road beyond the track leads to the godown, whose dark front is visible small in the distance in branch B.

Bhaiyaji's ration godown (called cold_storage in the loglines file). A high tin-roofed shed entered by one wide rolling shutter. Jute sacks stacked to the roof in blocks, each sack with a blank stencil patch (the government mark is spoken, not read). A green platform weighing scale with a round dial (no numerals). One truck backed in, FULLY LOADED under its grey tarpaulin, tailgate up, ready to leave (it is loaded by midnight in both branches); the floor beside it is bare where the last block of sacks stood. One bare bulb on a long wire. Outside view: the shutter mouth, a black rectangle with the bulb deep inside. Night only.

One narrow brick lane and one wooden double door with a stone step, an iron chain latch and a wall lamp on a bracket. This single plate stands for every complainant's door in branch A; the door colour, the lamp state (lit at night, off at dawn) and the light change from 1 a.m. blue to morning gold, and one small prop changes per door (a tulsi pot is NOT used; use a bicycle, a water pot, a charpai end). No signage.

A small court room, branch B only. A raised wooden desk seen from the front and side, with a file, a pen stand and a hand bell; the magistrate is hands only. A wooden witness stand with a rail to one side, where Nandini stands; a dock rail opposite, where Nirala stands. In front of the desk an EVIDENCE TABLE: twenty-four sealed envelopes in rows, the peaked cap, the brass medal, the wooden revolver lying on its side, and Pushpa's keypad phone in its knitted orange cover (the recording). A bench for the accused. High windows, flat daylight. No flags, no emblems, no portraits.

inserts_not_plates: Prison van (s2a03): a close insert of a barred grille in a blue-grey van door, a hand and a peaked cap behind it. No van exterior, no plate.
DSP's car (s2a02, s2a03): a white car door opening, seen through the real_thana doorway. No car plate.
Truck: appears inside crossing_stall (s2a01) and godown (s2b01, s2b02). One design: a dull orange cab, a high load under a grey tarpaulin, a blank number plate.

key_props.description: A square of grey cardboard on a loop of string, painted blank. The number is an overlay and is always spoken.
A wooden-handled rubber stamp Nirala cut himself and a small round tin ink pad. In s2a02 the ink pad takes thirty thumbs.
A fat cloth-tied file in red cloth: thirty complaints against Bhaiyaji. Pages painted blank. In s2a02 Nirala carries it clamped under his free left arm on the walk.

Brown envelopes sealed with a red wax blob, a blank tag on each: twenty-four of them, one a month for two years, each holding a bribe from Bhaiyaji with the note numbers written inside. They live on the projection-room racks (first seen in s2e01 b11). In branch A they are spoken of in s2a03 b6 and are not on screen: no beat brings them across the line.

A revolver carved from pale teak, visibly wood in close-up (grain, a knot, no metal), in a brown leather holster with a buttoned flap. RULE: holstered, lying on a table or scale, or held in profile. Never pointed at a face or at the camera.
Nirala's home-made medal: a blank brass-yellow disc as wide as a palm on a broad maroon-and-off-white striped ribbon with a safety pin.
One pair of plain steel handcuffs from the pouch on Nandini's belt. Branch A: on both Nirala's wrists in s2a01; his right wrist to her left wrist through s2a02; unlocked from her wrist in s2a03.
The real thana's FIR register: a large, heavy, green cloth-bound book, dusty, locked in the SHO's almirah for two years. Pages painted as ruled lines; thumbprints are painted, numbers are spoken.
A small steel key on a loop of orange wool from Pushpa's cardigan pocket.

A pink printed slip, painted blank. ONE FACT IN BOTH BRANCHES: Tripathi signed and stamped it that evening, before the choice. The signature is always spoken: by Nandini at the crossing (s2a01 b6), by Nirala on the open call (s2b01 b9, heard, not seen) and by Nandini as item three of the memo (s2b02 b7).

Nandini's phone, a plain black smartphone. Branch B: on an open call to Pushpa's phone, in Nirala's left chest pocket from s2b01 b5; found by Bhaiyaji, who cuts the call (s2b01 b11); lying face down on a sack in s2b02 until she picks it up again (b8). It is the microphone only: it holds NO recording.

Pushpa's phone, an old keypad handset with a knitted orange cover. Branch B: the listening end of the call and THE ONLY PLACE THE RECORDING EXISTS. Pushpa starts it and says so (s2b01 b5: 'Recording चालू है, madam।'), so cutting the call inside the godown cannot touch it. On the evidence table in s2b03.
The real thana's desk phone: a black landline handset with a coiled cord on the SHO's desk. Nandini rings the DSP on it (s2e01 b8); Tripathi rings Bhaiyaji on it (s2e02 b12).
Nirala's phone, a small keypad handset kept face up on his desk.
A wooden wall shield with a brass plate painted blank. What it is for is spoken in s2e01.
A printed pad with carbon paper, painted blank. Everything written on it is spoken as it is written.
One typed sheet, painted blank, with a pen lying across it. What it says is spoken by Bhaiyaji.
Bhaiyaji's fat ring of keys on his right index finger; the truck's own key hangs separately in the cab door.
Nandini's cherry-red open-face scooter helmet. In s2e02 b6 it goes into the ticket booth with her, so Bhaiyaji never sees it. In s2b02 b1 she leaves it on the stall bench.

branch_test.A: An all-night race on foot: an officer goes door to door with her own prisoner chained to her wrist, because he is the only person the town will open a door for, and turns thirty refused complaints into thirty registered FIRs before a press conference declares the town crime-free.
branch_test.B: A sting: an officer wires an unarmed impostor and sends him into a godown, the trap closes on him, she walks in after him with nothing but a memo pad, and days later a courtroom makes her choose between her own safety and the case.

shared_characters_accounted_for.A: All six appear. Bhaiyaji and the DSP arrive on screen at the end of s2a02.
shared_characters_accounted_for.B: The DSP is a phone voice in s2b02 and a signature on the suspension order in s2b03; he has no on-screen scene. All others appear.

beat_outlines.note: 'who' lists characters on screen; 'voices' lists characters heard but not seen. 'key_lines' are the lines the plot depends on: the writer may polish wording and timing, but the fact each one carries must be SPOKEN. Names in Hindi lines follow the script convention (Devanagari names, Latin acronyms). Beat ids are stable across the D-006 revision: s2e02 has no b9 (merged into b8), and that gap is deliberate. Length: see writer_notes.length_budget.

s2e01.what_happens: COLD OPEN, no establishing shot. First second: a khaki sleeve with the white lantern patch, a hand holding a grey cardboard token on a string (overlay: 7). A complainants' bench. A rubber stamp comes down off screen. A man's voice calls the number.
s2e01.reveal: A police officer is waiting her turn in a police station.
key_lines: nirala: अगला! Token सात।

s2e01.what_happens: Nandini stands, red helmet under her arm. At the desk: a small man in a too-big uniform and a peaked cap, a big brass medal on his chest, squaring a receipt. The complainant with token six leaves as a back. She tells him who she is.
s2e01.reveal: She is the real Sub-Inspector here, and this thana is not on her map.
key_lines: nandini: मैं इस इलाके की SI हूँ। और ये थाना मेरे record में है ही नहीं।

s2e01.what_happens: He looks at the two bars on her shoulder, not alarmed, and pours her tea. Wide shot for the first time: the desk is a cinema booking counter, the poster frames are empty, and the lockup behind him is a ticket booth with a grille.
s2e01.reveal: The police station is a shut cinema.
key_lines: nirala: बैठिए madam। पहले चाय, फिर complaint।

s2e01.what_happens: She does not sit. Quick exchange across the desk. He gives his name and rank without blinking. She looks at the one thing no officer of her force wears. He offers, helpfully, to take her complaint. She walks out with the token still in her fist.
s2e01.reveal: He calls himself Inspector Sudhir Nirala. The real force has no caps: his is the only one.
key_lines: nirala: Inspector सुधीर निराला। थाना इमलीपुर, line के इस पार।
nandini: इमलीपुर में एक ही थाना है। मेरा। और हमारे force में cap होती ही नहीं।
nirala: तो लिखवाइए, madam: 'थाना चोरी हो गया'।

s2e01.what_happens: Geography in one image, no dialogue: her scooter waits at the lowered railway gate by the tea stall; the talkies behind her, the town and her own thana ahead. A train horn. She looks at the token in her hand.
s2e01.reveal: The railway line cuts the town in two; the two thanas sit on either side of it.

s2e01.what_happens: The real thana: an empty, dusty complainants' bench. Tripathi under the zero-crime shield, eating peanuts. She reports what she saw; he does not get up. He points a peanut at the shield.
s2e01.reveal: The real thana has registered no FIR in two years and has a zero-crime shield for it. Its SHO is not surprised and not interested.
key_lines: tripathi: Talkies? अरे madam, दो साल से एक FIR नहीं। Zero crime। Shield देखिए।
tripathi: जहाँ complaint नहीं, वहाँ crime नहीं। मूँगफली लीजिए।

s2e01.what_happens: Pushpa, knitting at the side table, without looking up, mentions the paper that has come back from the DSP's office with a receipt stamp: Nandini's own transfer application. Nandini answers her, loud enough for Tripathi.
s2e01.reveal: Nandini has applied, on her own, to leave Imlipur after six weeks. It is pending with the DSP. (The six weeks may be spoken if the writer has room; the application must be.)
key_lines: pushpa: Madam, आपकी transfer application DSP साहब के office पहुँच गई।
nandini: जहाँ FIR ही नहीं लिखी जाती, वहाँ SI क्या करे?

s2e01.what_happens: She picks up the desk phone and dials the DSP herself, over Tripathi's 'अरे छोड़िए'. Close on her; the DSP is a brisk phone voice. She reports a second thana. He gives the order and the reason for the hour.
s2e01.reveal: The order: the man must be in her lockup before ten tomorrow. Ten is the DSP's press conference, at this thana, for its second zero-crime year. No reward is offered.
key_lines: dsp: मेरे ज़िले में नक़ली थाना? कल दस बजे मेरी press conference है, SI Joshi, आपके ही थाने में। उससे पहले वो आदमी lockup में चाहिए।

s2e01.what_happens: She puts the phone down. One image: Tripathi has stopped chewing, a peanut halfway to his mouth. Pushpa is already on her feet with her knitting bag, and says the first thing that suggests she knows more than she has said.
s2e01.reveal: Tripathi is frightened by the report. Pushpa knows the way to the talkies.
key_lines: pushpa: मैं चलती हूँ, madam। रास्ता मुझे पता है।

s2e01.what_happens: Afternoon, the talkies. She announces a seizure. Nirala does not argue or run: he hands the registers over himself, in order, squared, with an index, and leads her up the stair. Pushpa and Nirala nod to each other like colleagues.
s2e01.reveal: He has nothing to hide and wants the files read.
key_lines: nandini: सारे register ज़ब्त।
nirala: Register एक से नौ, madam। सबसे मोटी file ऊपर malkhana में है।

s2e01.what_happens: The projection room: racks of sealed envelopes and tied files where film cans were. She pulls down the thickest file, tied in red cloth, and unties it. Page after page (painted blank; date overlays support but do not carry). She says what she sees.
s2e01.reveal: Thirty complaints, all against one man: Bhaiyaji.
key_lines: nandini: तीस complaint। तीसों में एक ही नाम: भैयाजी।

s2e01.what_happens: ENDING, SPOKEN. Close on her face over the open file. She reads the top line of the first page aloud: a date, and whose thana refused it. She turns a page, then another: the same line. She says it as a statement, not a question. Pushpa's needles have stopped. Nandini's hand, which was going to the handcuff pouch on her belt, stops on it. Then the forward question, to Pushpa or to no one. Hold. Cut.
s2e01.reveal: Every one of the thirty was first taken to her own thana and turned away by her own SHO. The fake thana exists because the real one said no. The episode ends on what that does to tomorrow's order: who is she being sent to arrest?
key_lines: nandini: सत्रह मार्च। 'पहले इमलीपुर थाने गया था। SHO त्रिपाठी ने कहा: FIR नहीं लिखी जाएगी।'
nandini: तीस की तीस... मेरे ही थाने से लौटाई हुई हैं।
nandini: तो कल दस बजे से पहले... arrest किसे करूँ?

s2e02.what_happens: OPENS IN THE SAME ROOM, seconds later, no recap. Her handcuffs are already out. Nirala looks at them, then at the open file, and does not step back. He asks for one thing.
s2e02.reveal: He will not run. He wants time to hand his files over properly. (She sets the limit herself in b10: before ten tomorrow.)
key_lines: nirala: Arrest आपका हक़ है, madam। पर charge handover के बिना थाना नहीं छोड़ा जाता।
nandini: नक़ली थाने का charge handover?
nirala: थाना नक़ली है, madam। Complaint असली हैं।

s2e02.what_happens: THE SET-UP, AS A FOUR-LINE EXCHANGE. Nandini turns on Pushpa: you knew. Pushpa answers plainly, winding wool. Nandini asks about the SHO; Pushpa answers that too. Images: Pushpa's face; the shield as an insert on 'shield'. Nothing is said here about Bhaiyaji paying: b6 to b8 show the payment before anyone describes it.
s2e02.reveal: Why the fake thana lasted two years: every complaint Tripathi refused walked across the railway line (Pushpa sent them); Tripathi has known for two years; speaking would have cost him the shield, so he told neither the department nor Bhaiyaji. (That Bhaiyaji pays the place as his own outpost is not said here; it is shown in b6 to b8.)
key_lines: nandini: आपको पता था।
pushpa: भेजती मैं ही थी, madam। SHO साहब जिसे लौटाते, उसे line के पार।
nandini: और SHO साहब?
pushpa: दो साल से जानते हैं। बोलते, तो shield जाता। इसलिए ना department को बताया, ना भैयाजी को।

s2e02.what_happens: Downstairs a voice calls for 'निराला जी'. He excuses himself: token eight is waiting. She follows, cuffs still in her hand. On the bench side: two pairs of hands gripping one bicycle handlebar (the two neighbours are never faces and do not speak).
s2e02.reveal: The town calls him 'निराला जी', not Inspector.
key_lines: nirala: Token आठ।

s2e02.what_happens: He settles it from his own register: the frame number was written down the day the cycle was first reported lost. He says every word aloud as he writes it, and tells her why. One hand lets go of the handlebar. The stamp comes down; a receipt is torn off. She has been timing him.
s2e02.reveal: His rule: what you write, you say aloud, so the witness hears it. (Planted here; branch B pays it off.) The dispute took ten minutes.
key_lines: nirala: जो लिखो, बोलकर लिखो, madam। ताकि गवाह सुन ले।
nandini: दस minute।

s2e02.what_happens: The receipt is still in his hand when a car door shuts outside. Nirala goes still, and points her at the only place to hide. (The section-number correction that stood here is cut, D-006 change 8b; the failed candidate correcting the topper is kept for s2a02 b5.)
s2e02.reveal: Bhaiyaji comes here in person, and Nirala is afraid of him.
key_lines: nirala: भैयाजी। Madam... lockup में। मतलब... छुपिए।

s2e02.what_happens: COMIC IMAGE: the real Sub-Inspector stands inside the ticket-booth lockup, her eyes in the arched grille, her red helmet in the booth with her, held against her chest (it must not be left on the desk or the bench for Bhaiyaji to see). Bhaiyaji walks in, broad and unhurried, keys swinging from one finger, and lays an envelope on the desk.
s2e02.reveal: Bhaiyaji calls him 'Inspector साहब' and treats the place as an outpost he owns. (This name is his alone from here on.)
key_lines: bhaiyaji: Inspector साहब! इस महीने का।
bhaiyaji: हमारी चौकी, हमारे Inspector साहब। त्रिपाठी जी से सस्ते भी, मीठे भी।

s2e02.what_happens: Bhaiyaji asks about the thirty papers, smiling. Nirala takes the envelope in both hands and answers truthfully. Bhaiyaji flicks the brass medal with one finger and goes. The keys are the last thing out of the door.
s2e02.reveal: Bhaiyaji pays so that the thirty complaints stay asleep, and believes they are.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: और वो तीस काग़ज़... सो रहे हैं ना?
nirala: File में हैं, भैयाजी।

s2e02.what_happens: MERGED BEAT (old b8 and b9; there is no b9). Nandini comes out of the booth. He is already writing, aloud: the date, the amount, each note number. A blob of red wax, a blank tag. She says the word; he corrects it. He writes the envelope into the malkhana ledger lying open on the desk; her finger goes down the column of entries to the last one and she reads the count. He says how long he has waited. All in the lobby: the rows of envelopes on the projection-room racks were seen in s2e01 b11 and are not revisited.
s2e02.reveal: He takes every bribe and books it as seized property. This is the twenty-fourth: two years of Bhaiyaji's payments, sealed, dated, with note numbers. Evidence nobody real has ever asked for.
key_lines: nandini: आपने रिश्वत ली।
nirala: रिश्वत लेना जुर्म है, madam। ज़ब्त करना duty। ये case property है।
nandini: चौबीस।
nirala: दो साल से इंतज़ार है कि कोई असली अफ़सर इन्हें माँगे।

s2e02.what_happens: She asks why he did not simply join the police. He tells her, without self-pity. She puts the cuffs back in the pouch for now, gives him his day and sends Pushpa (who has come down the stair behind them) back across the line to watch the thana. Still in the lobby, at the desk.
s2e02.reveal: He failed the police entrance nine times, by one centimetre of chest. She grants him until morning.
key_lines: nirala: नौ बार। हर बार सीना एक centimetre कम निकला, madam। Complaint सुनने में सीना नहीं लगता।
nandini: कल दस बजे से पहले आप मेरे lockup में होंगे। तब तक... charge handover कीजिए।

s2e02.what_happens: Evening, the real thana, tube light. Pushpa is back at her knitting. Tripathi asks one question; her answer stops his jaw. He sends her for tea. She goes, slowly.
s2e02.reveal: Tripathi learns that Nandini has not arrested the man: she is reading his files, which name Tripathi thirty times.
key_lines: tripathi: Arrest हो गया?
pushpa: नहीं, SHO साहब। Madam files पढ़ रही हैं।

s2e02.what_happens: ENDING, SPOKEN. Tripathi alone under the shield. He wipes his hand on the gamchha, picks up the desk phone and dials. Close on his mouth and the receiver. He names who he is calling and what it is about. Cut on the last word, before any answer.
s2e02.reveal: Tripathi is telling Bhaiyaji something about the fake thana. What, and what Bhaiyaji says back, is not heard.
key_lines: tripathi: भैयाजी? त्रिपाठी बोल रहा हूँ। एक बात बतानी थी... वो talkies वाली चौकी के बारे में।

s2e03.what_happens: OPENS ON A SOUND: a keypad phone buzzing on Nirala's desk under the one bare bulb. Night. Nirala and Nandini both look at it. He says who it is. She tells him what to do.
s2e03.reveal: Bhaiyaji is calling the fake thana at half past ten at night.
key_lines: nirala: भैयाजी।
nandini: उठाइए। Speaker पर।

s2e03.what_happens: Bhaiyaji's voice fills the lobby, warm and ordinary. Close on the phone, then on Nirala's hands flat on the desk. The invitation has a dull, practical reason, and it is the same as every month.
s2e03.reveal: Midnight tonight, the godown: eight hundred sacks of ration grain leave town, and the 'outpost' must stamp the truck's movement slip because the railway crossing falls on its side. He is to come alone, as always.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: Inspector साहब, आज रात बारह बजे godown आ जाइए। आठ सौ बोरी निकल रही है। Crossing आपकी चौकी का है, slip पर मोहर चाहिए। हमेशा की तरह।
bhaiyaji: त्रिपाठी जी दस हज़ार लेते हैं। आप दो में ख़ुश। अकेले आइएगा।

s2e03.what_happens: The call ends. Nirala nods once at the phone: this is the monthly call. She sees what tonight is.
s2e03.reveal: He has gone and stamped a slip there every month (already spoken by Bhaiyaji: 'हमेशा की तरह'). Tonight is the biggest load, and tonight there is, for the first time, a real officer who could act on it. (The carbon copies and the eleven copies upstairs are cut, D-006 change 2: no later beat may rely on them.)
key_lines: nandini: आठ सौ बोरी। माल के साथ, रंगे हाथ।

s2e03.what_happens: Pushpa comes in from the dark, out of breath, knitting bag swinging: she has walked across the line. She tells Nandini what she heard at seven, and exactly where her knowledge stops.
s2e03.reveal: Tripathi's call to Bhaiyaji connected. Pushpa heard the word 'talkies'. Then the door was shut. Nobody knows what Bhaiyaji said back.
key_lines: pushpa: Madam। शाम को SHO साहब ने भैयाजी को phone किया। Call लगी। मैंने 'talkies' सुना। फिर दरवाज़ा बंद।
nandini: भैयाजी ने क्या कहा?
pushpa: वो किसी ने नहीं सुना।

s2e03.what_happens: Three people look at a silent phone. Nirala states the problem with a clerk's precision; his voice is thinner than before.
s2e03.reveal: The invitation proves nothing either way: the SHO's call was at seven, the invitation came after it, and it used the same words as every month.
key_lines: nirala: Call शाम की। बुलावा रात का। और शब्द वही... हर महीने वाले।

s2e03.what_happens: Nandini tries the lawful road. A raid needs men; the men are the SHO's. She phones the DSP on her own phone. Close on her; his voice through the phone. She reports the tip truthfully: she heard Bhaiyaji herself, on speaker (b2). He refuses, moves the order up to now, and names the price of helping. Her face as she hears it. (This is balance dial 3, now used.)
s2e03.reveal: No raid, no backup: the DSP will not raid on something heard on a fake thana's phone. The order is now 'lock him up at once'. And B's cost to her is spoken before the vote and never taken back: any officer who helps Nirala will be named in the same FIR.
key_lines: dsp: Information किसकी है?
nandini: भैयाजी की अपनी आवाज़, DSP साहब। निराला के phone पर।
dsp: नक़ली थाने के phone पर सुनी बात पर raid नहीं होती, SI Joshi। उसे अभी lockup में डालिए। जो अफ़सर उसकी मदद करेगा, उसी FIR में उसका नाम होगा।

s2e03.what_happens: She says both roads aloud, to Pushpa, flatly. One image for each: the empty ticket-booth lockup; the railway signal lamp through the lobby door.
s2e03.reveal: A's cost is closed in speech before the vote. If she arrests him now he is safe in her lockup tonight; Tripathi will stamp the slip in his place, and she cannot stop a truck that carries her own SHO's stamp, so the grain goes. If he goes, the invitation is in his name and only he can get inside: one chance at Bhaiyaji with the grain, on her word alone, against the order she has just been given. (She does not know, and nor does the viewer, that the slip is already stamped.)
key_lines: nandini: अभी arrest करूँ, तो ये मेरे lockup में हैं। ज़िंदा। पर मोहर SHO साहब लगा देंगे, और मोहर लगा truck मैं रोक नहीं सकती।
nandini: जाने दूँ, तो अंदर सिर्फ़ यही जा सकते हैं। मेरे कहने पर। Order के ख़िलाफ़।

s2e03.what_happens: She asks about the one thing on his belt. He unbuttons the holster flap and lays the revolver on the desk, in profile, under the bulb: pale wood, grain, a knot. His hand is not steady. PLAYED STRAIGHT: no joke, no comic tag, no music sting.
s2e03.reveal: His revolver is carved teak and has never left its holster. He cannot defend himself.
key_lines: nandini: आपके पास revolver है।
nirala: लकड़ी की है, madam। सागौन। ख़ुद तराशी थी। दो साल में कभी holster से निकाली नहीं।
nirala: उनके पास असली है।

s2e03.what_happens: He holds out both wrists across the desk, sleeves over his knuckles, and leaves it to her. Frightened, formal, steady.
s2e03.reveal: He will do either. He says outright that he is not police and she is.
key_lines: nirala: मैं police नहीं हूँ, madam। आप हैं। आप कहें तो जाता हूँ। आप कहें तो...

s2e03.what_happens: ENDING, SPOKEN: THE QUESTION. One held frame: his two wrists low in frame, her right hand holding the open handcuffs above them, the wooden revolver on the desk between. Then her face. The clock hands at eleven. She asks it aloud, low and clear, to Pushpa or to no one. Hold. The stage keeps this frame for the question card.
key_lines: nandini: इन्हें हथकड़ी लगाऊँ, या आज रात Inspector बनने दूँ?

s2a01.what_happens: OPENS ON A SOUND: the ratchet of handcuffs. The steel closes on the two wrists held out at the end of s2e03. She says the words of arrest, exactly. He bows his head once. He asks for one thing.
s2a01.reveal: She chose the book. He is under arrest. (Glimpse A opens on this image and his line.)
key_lines: nandini: सुधीर निराला। Police अफ़सर बनकर थाना चलाने के जुर्म में, आप under arrest हैं।
nirala: जी, madam। बस... cap रहने दीजिए।

s2a01.what_happens: The wooden revolver, on the desk, goes into a cloth bag and is sealed with his own red wax. Out of habit he dictates the label for his own case property; she writes it. Pushpa switches off the bulb. The lobby goes dark behind three figures.
s2a01.reveal: The fake thana is shut. He helps book himself.
key_lines: nirala: 'एक revolver, लकड़ी की। मुलज़िम से बरामद।' तारीख़ डाल दीजिए, madam।

s2a01.what_happens: One wide still: the railway crossing at night, the signal lamp, three silhouettes stepping over the track: a tall straight one, a short square one with needles in her bun, and between them a small one under a level peaked cap. No dialogue.
s2a01.reveal: He crosses the line to the real thana for the first time.

s2a01.what_happens: The real lockup: Pushpa fights a rusted lock; a cobweb across the bars. He steps in, dusts the bench with his handkerchief and sits bolt upright, cap level, medal on. The barred door closes on a man in full uniform. (Glimpse A image.)
s2a01.reveal: He is the first prisoner in the real lockup in two years.
key_lines: pushpa: दो साल में पहला मुलज़िम। ताला ही भूल गया था कि खुलना कैसे है।

s2a01.what_happens: The clock hands meet at twelve. Through the bars he looks at it and says where he should be. She picks up her helmet and goes without answering.
s2a01.reveal: Midnight: the godown is expecting him. (Glimpse A line.)
key_lines: nirala: बारह। भैयाजी इंतज़ार कर रहे होंगे।

s2a01.what_happens: The crossing. The gate arm is down; a loaded truck idles behind it under a grey tarpaulin. She steps into its headlights with her hand up and gives the order. (GLIMPSE A ENDS HERE, on her first line; nothing after it is in the glimpse.) A forearm comes out of the cab holding a pink slip (painted blank). She reads who signed it, aloud, and then says what that means for her.
s2a01.reveal: The truck's papers are in order: the movement slip was signed and stamped by her own SHO, before midnight (in fact that evening: see timeline.shared). It is what she said would happen in s2e03 b7, sooner than she thought. Bhaiyaji did not need the outpost's stamp after all.
key_lines: nandini: रोकिए। काग़ज़ दिखाइए।
nandini: आठ सौ बोरी। और sign... SHO त्रिपाठी के। मोहर समेत।
nandini: काग़ज़ पूरे हैं।

s2a01.what_happens: She has no order, no information on record and a slip she cannot fault. She hands it back. The gate arm rises. Held image: red tail-lights going away over the railway line, her back to camera, helmet in her hand. She says the time and what she did, like an entry. (Not in Glimpse A.)
s2a01.reveal: The grain leaves town, and she is the officer who let it pass. This is the cost of A, on screen.
key_lines: nandini: बारह बजकर दस minute। आठ सौ बोरी। मैंने जाने दिया।

s2a01.what_happens: Back at the bars. He asks; she tells him. He turns the one new fact over like a clerk: if the SHO's stamp was already on the slip, his own was never needed. She finishes the thought. His hand goes to his collar.
s2a01.reveal: The inference comes from the slip, not from a phone that did not ring: the slip was already stamped, so the midnight invitation was never for a stamp. It was for him. (Inferred, not confirmed. What A bought is visible: Nirala is on this side of the bars.)
key_lines: nirala: Truck गया?
nandini: गया। SHO साहब के sign पर।
nirala: मोहर पहले से SHO साहब की थी, madam? तो मेरी मोहर की ज़रूरत ही नहीं थी।
nandini: मतलब बुलावा मोहर के लिए नहीं था। आपके लिए था।

s2a01.what_happens: He gets up and comes to the bars. The grain is gone; he tells her what is not, and why ten o'clock is the only chance. His voice through the bars. (Not in Glimpse A.)
s2a01.reveal: The new clock, with its mechanism: his files are paper from a thana that never existed, so the thirty complaints count only if they are in the real register. At ten there will be microphones in this thana, and a register laid in front of them cannot be buried. After that it goes back into the SHO's almirah.
key_lines: nirala: माल गया, madam। Complaint नहीं गईं। पर मेरी files नक़ली थाने का काग़ज़ हैं।
nirala: सुबह दस बजे इस थाने में microphone होंगे, madam। उनके सामने रखा register कोई दबा नहीं सकता। उसके बाद... SHO साहब की almirah।
nirala: असली register में चढ़ाइए। FIR लिखिए, madam।

s2a01.what_happens: The FIR register is in the SHO's locked almirah. Nandini looks at the padlock. Pushpa takes a loop of orange wool from her cardigan pocket: a key on it. The almirah opens; the big green register comes out in a puff of dust. Blank ruled pages.
s2a01.reveal: Pushpa has had a second key all along. The register has been blank for two years.
key_lines: pushpa: दूसरी चाबी, madam। दो साल से किसी के माँगने का इंतज़ार कर रही थी।

s2a01.what_happens: ENDING, SPOKEN. One a.m., a lane. The red file under her arm, the green register in her hands. She knocks. The door opens a hand's width: Ramsevak (the one face of this episode). She says why she has come. He looks at the bars on her shoulder, not at her. The door shuts. Hold on the shut door and her raised hand. (Not in Glimpse A.)
s2a01.reveal: The people who trusted the fake uniform will not open the door to the real one.
key_lines: nandini: FIR लिखने आई हूँ। भैयाजी के ख़िलाफ़।
door1_man: असली थाने में एक बार जा चुके हैं, madam।

s2a02.what_happens: OPENS ON A SOUND: a key in the lockup door, twenty minutes later. She walks in, takes the cuff off his left wrist and snaps it on her own left wrist. His right stays in the other ring. She gives him the red file; he clamps it under his free left arm, where it stays all night. Pushpa's eyebrows go up over her spectacles.
s2a02.reveal: She is taking her prisoner out, chained to herself: he is the only person the doors will open for.
key_lines: nandini: मुझे ज़मानत चाहिए, निराला जी। आपकी नहीं। मेरी। चलिए।

s2a02.what_happens: RUNNING GAG, FIRST TIME. On the way out he salutes Pushpa, as he salutes everyone, with his right hand: her left arm is yanked up with it. One image: two arms in the air, one chain. Pushpa returns the salute gravely to both.
s2a02.reveal: Every salute of his is now also hers.
key_lines: nirala: माफ़ कीजिए, madam। आदत है।

s2a02.what_happens: The same shut door as the end of s2a01. This time he knocks: his own knock. It opens a hand's width: a hand only, no face. He does the vouching, and it costs him to say it. He lifts their joined wrists into the lamplight as proof. The door opens.
s2a02.reveal: A fake policeman vouches for a real one, by confessing.
key_lines: nirala: रामसेवक भाई। ये असली हैं। नक़ली मैं था।
nirala: यक़ीन ना हो तो हथकड़ी देख लीजिए।

s2a02.what_happens: There is no table. The green register lies open across their two chained forearms; he holds the tin ink pad in his free left hand; she writes with her right. A thumb comes down on the pad, then on the page. Close on the first print.
s2a02.reveal: FIR number one: the first in two years, written on a desk made of two arms.
key_lines: nandini: FIR number एक।

s2a02.what_happens: Walking, out of step, the chain jerking. He reads her entry upside down and cannot help himself. She bristles, then changes it.
s2a02.reveal: He knows the drafting better than she does, and she lets him be right.
key_lines: nirala: धारा पहले, madam। तारीख़ बाद में।
nandini: Academy topper मैं हूँ।
nirala: और नौ बार fail मैं। Syllabus मुझे ज़्यादा बार पढ़ना पड़ा।

s2a02.what_happens: Second face: Shanti Devi, a steel tumbler in her hand, will not believe it. He answers gently. She gives her thumb, then scolds Nandini for the chain. Nandini's first almost-smile of the series.
s2a02.reveal: What the town owes him is small and real: a found goat. The chain has changed meaning.
key_lines: door2_woman: निराला जी नक़ली? इन्होंने तो मेरी बकरी ढूँढी थी!
nirala: बकरी असली थी, अम्मा। वर्दी नक़ली थी।
door2_woman: इतने भले आदमी को बाँध रखा है?
nandini: बाँधा इन्होंने है, अम्मा। मुझे।

s2a02.what_happens: The night as objects, not people: thumb on pad, print on page, a page filling with prints, the lane lamp going out as the sky pales. Out of habit he hands someone a cardboard token; she takes it back and puts it in her pocket. The count is spoken.
s2a02.reveal: The register is filling. The fake thana's habits are being retired one by one.
key_lines: nirala: Token ग्यारह।
nandini: अब token नहीं, निराला जी। अब FIR number। ग्यारह।

s2a02.what_happens: Dawn at the crossing stall: two glasses of tea, one chain. Each time he lifts his glass her hand rises with it; she lets it, and times her own sips to his. He says the thing he has understood tonight. She answers.
s2a02.reveal: He names the difference between his thana and hers; she names what hers owes his.
key_lines: nirala: मेरे register में सिर्फ़ तसल्ली थी, madam। आपके में सज़ा है।
nandini: आपका register ना होता, तो मेरा आज भी ख़ाली होता।

s2a02.what_happens: Third face: Mukesh, holding up a folded stamped receipt. He already has one, from निराला जी, and that is enough for him. Nirala has to disown his own stamp to the face of a man who believed in it. It is the hardest thing he does in the series. Mukesh gives his thumb.
s2a02.reveal: The turn of the episode: the fake inspector tells the town not to trust him, so that it will trust her.
key_lines: door3_man: Receipt है मेरे पास। निराला जी की मोहर वाली।
nirala: वो मोहर मैंने रबर काटकर ख़ुद बनाई थी, मुकेश। उस पर भरोसा मत करो। इन पर करो।

s2a02.what_happens: THE DOOR NIRALA CANNOT OPEN. Morning light. He knocks his own knock; the door opens a hand's width on its chain: a hand, no face (door4_voice; not a fourth face). His vouching fails for the first time: the voice turns the handcuffs against him. He has no answer and looks at his own wrist. Nandini steps in front of him, lifts the chain into the light herself, and wins the door with the one thing only she can say: last night's grain went past her. The hand slides the chain off; a thumb comes out for the ink pad.
s2a02.reveal: The lead wins one door herself, by owning her cost from the crossing. The town can trust the real uniform for a reason of its own, not only on Nirala's word.
key_lines: door4_voice: जो ख़ुद हथकड़ी में है, वो हमें क्या बचाएगा, निराला जी?
nandini: हथकड़ी मेरी है। और कल रात आपका अनाज मेरे सामने से गया। FIR लिखवाइए, ताकि दोबारा ना जाए।

s2a02.what_happens: The clock against them: one image of two pairs of feet, hers in black shoes, his in too-big ones, hurrying, at last in step, as she says the time and the count. Then the last door closes behind them. She shuts the register on the thirtieth print. He starts to salute the house, and this time her arm goes up with his before the chain pulls. GAG PAID: she is saluting with him by choice.
s2a02.reveal: Half past nine, twenty-seven done; then thirty FIRs, registered, with ten minutes to spare.
key_lines: nandini: साढ़े नौ। सत्ताईस।
nandini: तीस।

s2a02.what_happens: ENDING, SPOKEN. Five to ten. They step in through the thana's front doorway, still chained. The office is dressed: a table of microphones, the shield polished. Behind them, through the same doorway, a white car door opens. The DSP steps out (first time on screen), and from the other door, a marigold garland round his neck, Bhaiyaji. Pushpa says it. Hold on Nandini's hand tightening on the register.
s2a02.reveal: The man named in all thirty FIRs is the DSP's chief guest.
key_lines: pushpa: DSP साहब आ गए, madam। और साथ में chief guest... भैयाजी।

s2a03.what_happens: OPENS MID-SPEECH: a squeal of microphone feedback. The DSP at the table of microphones, Bhaiyaji garlanded in a chair beside him, Tripathi standing behind with his peanuts. Camera shutters as sound; no audience in frame. Nandini walks into the shot chained to Nirala.
key_lines: dsp: इमलीपुर थाना: लगातार दूसरे साल, zero crime।

s2a03.what_happens: The DSP sees the peaked cap and is delighted: here is his finished arrest. She unlocks the cuff from her own wrist and gives the chain to Pushpa. She has done what she was told.
s2a03.reveal: The order is obeyed, on time, in front of the press.
key_lines: dsp: और ये रहा नक़ली Inspector: arrest। शाबाश, SI Joshi।
nandini: Order पूरा, DSP साहब।

s2a03.what_happens: She sets the green register down among the microphones. The DSP's hand moves to cover the nearest one.
s2a03.reveal: She has brought something he did not order.
key_lines: nandini: और ये: कल रात की तीस FIR।
dsp: बाद में, Joshi।

s2a03.what_happens: She opens the register and reads the first entry into the microphone he did not cover. On the name, cut to Bhaiyaji: the smile holds, but the sunglasses slide off the top of his head onto his nose. The shutters stop for a breath; then one reporter's voice from off screen, the only time the press is heard as a person.
s2a03.reveal: The chief guest is the accused in FIR number one, it has now been said into microphones, and the press has understood it.
key_lines: nandini: FIR number एक। आरोपी: बलराम ठाकुर, उर्फ़ भैयाजी। जुर्म: उगाही।
reporter: DSP साहब, chief guest ही आरोपी हैं?

s2a03.what_happens: Tripathi finds his voice. Pushpa holds up a key on a loop of orange wool. Nandini reads the line that is the same in all thirty, and then her own entry from last night.
s2a03.reveal: All thirty FIRs record that the SHO refused them first; and the station diary has the truck leaving at ten past twelve on his signature.
key_lines: tripathi: ये register तो almirah में बंद था!
pushpa: दूसरी चाबी, SHO साहब।
nandini: तीसों में एक ही line: 'SHO त्रिपाठी ने FIR लिखने से मना किया।' और कल रात आठ सौ बोरी आपके sign पर निकली।

s2a03.what_happens: Bhaiyaji, unhurried, appeals to the DSP: this is a conman's paper. Nirala, in cuffs beside Pushpa, answers him, formal and steady. It is the only time he speaks to Bhaiyaji as an equal.
s2a03.reveal: Nothing on the table is Nirala's: real register, real thumbs, real officer. And for two years Bhaiyaji paid his bribes to a fake, who sealed every one.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: DSP साहब, एक नक़ली Inspector के काग़ज़ पर—
nirala: काग़ज़ मेरे नहीं हैं, भैयाजी। Register असली, अँगूठे असली, अफ़सर असली। नक़ली सिर्फ़ मैं था।
nirala: और आपके चौबीस लिफ़ाफ़े: case property।

s2a03.what_happens: Close on the DSP: one pause, one calculation, with the shutters going. He takes his hand off the microphone and takes the credit. He turns to Pushpa.
s2a03.reveal: He cannot bury thirty FIRs read out in front of the press, so he owns them. Bhaiyaji and Tripathi are to be taken into custody.
key_lines: dsp: ...और आज से, इमलीपुर police इन तीस मामलों में कार्रवाई कर रही है।
dsp: Head Constable। इन दोनों को हिरासत में लीजिए।

s2a03.what_happens: Two single images. Tripathi's paper cone on the floor, peanuts rolling. Pushpa lifting the zero-crime shield off its nail and laying it face down on the SHO's desk. Nandini does not let the DSP round it up.
s2a03.reveal: Zero is over. The cost of last night is not refunded: the grain is gone for good.
key_lines: pushpa: Zero अब zero नहीं रहा, SHO साहब।
nandini: और आठ सौ बोरी नहीं लौटेगी, DSP साहब। वो मेरे सामने से गई थी।

s2a03.what_happens: The room emptying. The DSP, aside, taps a paper in his file: her transfer application. He offers to sign it today, as a kindness. She takes it back out of his file.
s2a03.reveal: She withdraws her own application. She is staying.
key_lines: dsp: आपकी transfer application, Joshi। आज sign कर दूँ?
nandini: वापस ले रही हूँ, DSP साहब। यहाँ तीस FIR pending हैं।

s2a03.what_happens: THE SAME MORNING, straight after the press conference; no time jump. The thana yard. Close insert: the barred grille of a prison-van door. Nirala behind it, still in his uniform, cap and medal, which is why he is still dressed as he was; no chain between them now. He tells her what he is going to do, as a clerk reports a decision. She reaches through the bars and sets his cap level.
s2a03.reveal: He is going to plead guilty. No sentence is named anywhere: none has been passed, and no law was checked.
key_lines: nirala: जुर्म क़बूल करूँगा, madam। वर्दी नक़ली थी।
nandini: काम असली था। Cap सीधी रखिए।

s2a03.what_happens: FINAL IMAGE, resolution. Through the grille he salutes. Nothing pulls her arm this time. She returns the salute, straight-backed, of her own will. Behind her, through the thana doorway, the complainants' bench: for the first time, people are waiting. They are last night's complainants, come to the real thana by daylight (three pairs of hands holding papers, no faces; one hand may hold a folded stamped receipt). Pushpa's voice from inside. Nandini holds the salute as the van's engine is heard pulling away.
key_lines: pushpa: Madam, bench भर गई है।

s2b01.what_happens: OPENS ON THE HELD FRAME of s2e03: her hand closes over his two wrists and pushes them down. The handcuffs go back into the pouch on her belt. Pushpa starts to object; Nandini has already decided.
s2b01.reveal: She chose the night, knowing the price the DSP named at 10:30. She does not argue that she is inside the order: she is breaking it, and her name will be written with his.
key_lines: nandini: एक रात और। मेरी ज़िम्मेदारी पर।
pushpa: Madam, DSP साहब का order—
nandini: Order मैंने सुना है, पुष्पा जी। नाम मेरा ही लिखा जाएगा।

s2b01.what_happens: She dresses him like an officer of her own force. Three single images: her hands pulling his belt tight and tucking the loose tail; squaring the drooping shoulder seams; folding back the cuffs so his hands show. He stands like a boy being measured.
s2b01.reveal: For the first time the uniform nearly fits.

s2b01.what_happens: Her fingers on the brass medal. She unpins it (Glimpse B image). He looks stricken. She puts it in her own left chest pocket and buttons the flap.
s2b01.reveal: She takes away the one thing too many, and makes it a promise that he is coming back.
key_lines: nandini: मेरे force में ये नहीं होता।
nandini: लौटकर ले लीजिएगा।

s2b01.what_happens: The wooden revolver, in profile, slides into the brown holster; her hand buttons the flap (Glimpse B image).
s2b01.reveal: He goes in with a piece of teak.
key_lines: nandini: निकालिएगा मत।
nirala: दो साल से नहीं निकाली, madam।

s2b01.what_happens: She dials Pushpa's old keypad phone from her own. Pushpa answers, presses one key on her handset to start recording, and says so. Nandini drops her own phone, screen in, into his left chest pocket, where the medal was. She gives him his own rule back, and they agree a word for danger.
s2b01.reveal: He is wired: an open call from her phone to Pushpa's. THE RECORDING IS MADE AND KEPT ON PUSHPA'S HANDSET, at the listening end, so nothing done to the phone in his pocket can touch it. He is to get the slip, the count and Bhaiyaji's own voice. The danger word is 'चाय'.
key_lines: pushpa: Recording चालू है, madam।
nandini: जो देखें, बोलकर देखिए। ताकि गवाह सुन ले।
nandini: Slip, बोरी की गिनती, और भैयाजी की अपनी आवाज़। ख़तरा लगे तो कहिएगा: 'चाय ठंडी हो गई।'

s2b01.what_happens: The crossing, a few minutes to twelve. They stop at the gate arm. He salutes her; she returns it. He walks on alone: wide still, a small figure under a level cap going up the dark road toward the black mouth of the godown (Glimpse B image).
s2b01.reveal: He goes alone. She cannot follow without ending it.
key_lines: nandini: जाइए, निराला जी।

s2b01.what_happens: The tea stall, shut, one bulb. Two women on the bench, Pushpa's phone on speaker between them on her knitting. Sounds only: his footsteps on gravel, a shutter rattling up, Bhaiyaji's warm welcome. Nandini's pen is out over her notebook.
s2b01.reveal: He is in. The line is clear.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: आइए, आइए, Inspector साहब।

s2b01.what_happens: Cut to the godown mouth from outside: the small figure steps into the bulb-light among the sacks, and the shutter comes down behind him. A second after the rattle dies, his voice on the line, back at the stall: FULL VOICE, formal, spoken to Bhaiyaji, never to her. He stays in cover: he reports the danger to the listeners by asking the man in the room a question. (Glimpse B ends on this line.)
s2b01.reveal: He is shut in, and he has kept his head: he does not say 'madam' with Bhaiyaji in the room.
key_lines: nirala: Shutter क्यों गिरा दिया गया, भैयाजी?

s2b01.what_happens: On the line he does the job, saying everything he sees. Bhaiyaji obliges. Nandini writes it down; for half a minute it is working. Pushpa's needles slow. Then paper rustles: he has the slip in his hand, and, because he says aloud whatever he reads, he reads out the one thing he should not have seen. Nandini's pen stops.
s2b01.reveal: Bhaiyaji, in his own voice, on a recording: eight hundred sacks, government-marked, leaving tonight. Then the fact that sets off the reversal: the slip already carries the SHO's signature and stamp. Nobody needed Nirala's.
key_lines: nirala: Slip दीजिए, भैयाजी। आठ सौ बोरी... सरकारी छाप वाली।
bhaiyaji: पूरी आठ सौ। गिन लीजिए।
nirala: Slip पर तो SHO साहब के sign पहले से हैं, भैयाजी...

s2b01.what_happens: Bhaiyaji answers the slip with a laugh, close to the phone, and says the worst thing. Close on Nandini's face as she hears it. Pushpa's needles stop. Nandini states the reversal herself, in her own unfiltered voice, at the stall.
s2b01.reveal: REVERSAL: Bhaiyaji knows he is a fake, and has been waiting for him. The invitation was a trap; Tripathi told him. The lead says it in one clean line, so the turn does not depend on a phone-filtered voice.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: नक़ली Inspector! आइए... आप ही का तो इंतज़ार था।
nandini: इन्हें पता था।

s2b01.what_happens: ENDING, SPOKEN. A rustle of cloth against the microphone; Bhaiyaji's voice right on top of it; then the flat tone of a dead line. Nandini is on her feet, the medal a weight in her pocket. Pushpa says it. Hold on the keypad phone, its screen going dark.
s2b01.reveal: Bhaiyaji has found the phone and cut the call. Nandini has lost her ears inside and her own phone, which now ties her to the man in the godown. Everything up to this second is safe on Pushpa's handset.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: और ये जेब में phone किसका है?
pushpa: Madam... line कट गई।

s2b02.what_happens: OPENS ON THE DEAD TONE. Nandini is already walking, helmet left on the bench. Pushpa hurries after with the phone and the knitting bag. Three lines, on the move, across the track.
s2b02.reveal: No backup, no order, and her own phone is in his pocket. She goes anyway.
key_lines: pushpa: Force, madam?
nandini: आप हैं ना।

s2b02.what_happens: Inside the godown. Nirala sits very upright on a sack, cap level, hands on his knees. Bhaiyaji, keys swinging, sets a typed sheet (painted blank) and a pen on the platform of the weighing scale and says what it is. Nandini's phone lies face down on a sack beside him.
s2b02.reveal: The plan: a 'fake police gang' looted the ration grain; Nirala signs as its leader; Tripathi is on his way to arrest him, and the DSP gets his arrest before ten. Bhaiyaji becomes the victim and the file closes.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: 'नक़ली police gang ने सरकारी अनाज लूटा। सरगना: सुधीर निराला।' Sign कर दीजिए।
bhaiyaji: त्रिपाठी जी आ रहे हैं, आपको arrest करने। DSP साहब को एक arrest ही तो चाहिए।

s2b02.what_happens: Bhaiyaji unbuttons Nirala's holster and lifts the revolver out, in profile; knocks it on a sack: wood. He laughs and lays it on the scale; the needle hardly moves. Nirala, shaking, reads the confession and, because he cannot help it, finds two faults in it. He does not sign. Under his breath, to a phone that is no longer listening, he says the danger word.
s2b02.reveal: Frightened, he is still a better clerk than the man threatening him. He will not sign.
key_lines: nirala: इसमें तारीख़ ग़लत है, भैयाजी। और 'gang' में कम से कम दो लोग चाहिए।
nirala: ...चाय ठंडी हो गई।

s2b02.what_happens: Three blows on the steel shutter from outside. A woman's voice. Bhaiyaji smiles: Tripathi is early. The shutter goes up on Nandini in full uniform, straight as a post in the spill of the godown bulb, and Pushpa one step behind her. It is about a quarter past twelve.
s2b02.reveal: The real police have arrived, and it is not the one he bought.
key_lines: nandini: Police। Shutter खोलिए।

s2b02.what_happens: Bhaiyaji recovers in one breath and offers her the easy way out: the very arrest she was ordered to make. He waves her toward Nirala like a host. She looks at Nirala, at the loaded truck, at the wooden revolver on the scale.
s2b02.reveal: She can take Nirala, obey her order and walk out safe. Bhaiyaji is counting on it.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: Madam! अच्छा हुआ आप आ गईं। नक़ली Inspector पकड़ा है, अनाज चुरा रहा था। ले जाइए।

s2b02.what_happens: She takes out the memo pad, clicks her blue pen and starts to write, aloud, as he taught her. Pushpa names herself as witness. Close on the pen; on Nirala's face as he understands what she is doing.
s2b02.reveal: She uses the only weapon she has: a seizure memo, spoken as it is written, in front of a witness. (Pay-off of the s2e02 rule.)
key_lines: nandini: Seizure memo। रात बारह बजकर बीस minute। बलराम ठाकुर का godown।
pushpa: गवाह: Head Constable पुष्पा कुमारी।

s2b02.what_happens: Item by item, one image each: a sack with its stencil patch (item one); the fully loaded truck (item two, written without a spoken line); the pink slip, which lies on the scale beside the unsigned confession; she picks it up and reads it (item three). Nirala, from his sack, supplies the count like a munshi. Bhaiyaji points out that she is alone; she writes him down.
s2b02.reveal: The grain, the loaded truck, the slip with her own SHO's signature on it and the owner on the spot are now on paper in an officer's hand. Item three is the same fact branch A reads at the crossing.
key_lines: nandini: Item एक: सरकारी छाप की बोरी।
nirala: आठ सौ, madam। सब truck में।
nandini: Item तीन: movement slip। Sign: SHO त्रिपाठी के।
bhaiyaji: Madam, आप अकेली हैं।
nandini: Item चार: मालिक, मौक़े पर हाज़िर।

s2b02.what_happens: She holds out her hand for the truck key. Bhaiyaji does not move. Pushpa walks to the cab, takes the key out of the door and drops it into her cardigan pocket with the wool. Nandini picks her own phone up off the sack.
s2b02.reveal: The truck is going nowhere. She has her phone back. The recording was never on it: it is on Pushpa's handset, in Pushpa's hand, and Bhaiyaji cutting the call did not touch it.
key_lines: nandini: Item पाँच: truck की चाबी। ज़ब्त।

s2b02.what_happens: Headlights sweep the sacks. Tripathi walks in, gamchha on his shoulder, peanuts in hand, ready to arrest a gang, and finds his own Sub-Inspector writing. She does not look up.
s2b02.reveal: The SHO has come to the scene of the theft at half past twelve at night, called by nobody in the police, and is now an item in the memo, three items below his own signature.
key_lines: tripathi: ये क्या तमाशा है, Joshi?
nandini: Item छह: SHO दयाशंकर त्रिपाठी। रात साढ़े बारह बजे, मौक़े पर हाज़िर।

s2b02.what_happens: She dials the DSP. Close on her; his voice on the phone. This time he cannot refuse: she answers his own words from 10:30. A pause, then an order. (He does not take back what he said about any officer who helps the impostor; the script must not let him.)
s2b02.reveal: The DSP is sending a force: an officer's seizure memo with a witness is not 'something heard on a fake thana's phone', and he has to act on it. Her own position is unchanged.
key_lines: nandini: DSP साहब, SI Joshi। अब बात नक़ली थाने के phone की नहीं है। Seizure memo मेरे हाथ का है: आठ सौ बोरी, गवाह समेत। Force भेजिए।
dsp: ...बीस minute।

s2b02.what_happens: Bhaiyaji sits down slowly on a sack. The smile is gone from his face for the first time in the series. He nods at the black phone in Nandini's hand and tells Tripathi, who arrived after it was found, where it came from. Nirala, without being asked, picks his wooden revolver off the scale and holds it out to Nandini, butt first and in profile, as case property.
s2b02.reveal: Bhaiyaji has run out of moves of his own, and hands Tripathi the one fact he needs: the phone in the impostor's pocket was hers. Tripathi learns it on screen.
key_lines: bhaiyaji: इनकी जेब से madam का phone निकला है, त्रिपाठी जी। कुछ कीजिए।

s2b02.what_happens: ENDING, SPOKEN. Tripathi crushes a peanut shell in his fist. He looks at Nirala, at the phone in Nandini's hand, at her. He points at her with a finger (a finger only). Close on her face; her hand goes to the pocket where the medal is. Hold.
s2b02.reveal: Tripathi draws the conclusion aloud from what Bhaiyaji has just told him: she sent the impostor in. The seizure holds only as long as nobody asks who did; he will say it in court.
key_lines: tripathi: तो इसे अंदर madam ने भेजा। Court में मैं यही बोलूँगा: madam को सब पता था।

s2b03.what_happens: OPENS INSIDE THE QUESTION, days later. A court room. Nandini in the witness stand, in uniform. A black-coated back, a hand holding a pen. On the evidence table: twenty-four sealed envelopes, a peaked cap, a brass medal, a wooden revolver. The question is already in the air.
s2b03.reveal: It is the bail hearing, and the defence has made the whole case about the fake inspector.
key_lines: defence_lawyer: SI Joshi। हाँ या ना। क्या आपको पता था कि ये आदमी police नहीं है?

s2b03.what_happens: The lawyer lays out both answers for her, pleasantly, pen tapping. One image for each: Nirala in the dock, bare-headed for the first time in the series, flat side-parted hair; Bhaiyaji on the bench, calm, sunglasses folded in his hand, Tripathi beside him without his peanuts.
s2b03.reveal: If she says no, an impostor broke into a godown on his own: the gang, the grain and the blame are his, and she is safe. If she says yes, she sent a fake policeman in against her DSP's order.
key_lines: defence_lawyer: 'ना' कहिए, तो एक बहुरूपिया godown में घुसा: gang उसका, मेरे मुवक्किल शिकार।
defence_lawyer: 'हाँ' कहिए... तो order के ख़िलाफ़ एक नक़ली police वाले को आपने भेजा।

s2b03.what_happens: Nirala cannot bear it. He grips the dock rail and takes it all on himself, formal even now. The magistrate's hand comes down on the hand bell.
s2b03.reveal: He is trying to save her by lying.
key_lines: nirala: हुज़ूर, madam को कुछ पता नहीं था! मैं अकेला गया था—
magistrate: आप चुप रहिए। सवाल गवाह से है।

s2b03.what_happens: A held beat on Nandini. In the public seats, Pushpa, knitting still in her lap. On the evidence table, the medal. Her hand on the rail of the stand. Everyone in the room has offered her the safe answer.
s2b03.reveal: The lie is free, and it would be believed.

s2b03.what_happens: She turns to the dock first, and stops him. Then she faces the desk and answers, low, clear, exact. Three short sentences.
s2b03.reveal: She tells the truth: she knew, she sent him, the phone was hers, and the decision was hers alone.
key_lines: nandini: निराला जी। बयान मेरा है।
nandini: पता था। इन्हें मैंने भेजा। Phone मेरा था। फ़ैसला भी मेरा।

s2b03.what_happens: She goes on before the lawyer can enjoy it, and says why her answer decides the case. Close on Pushpa's keypad phone in its knitted orange cover on the evidence table; on Bhaiyaji's hand closing on his folded sunglasses. The lawyer's pen stops tapping.
s2b03.reveal: Why the truth decides the case, in speech: a phone found in an impostor's pocket is evidence of nothing, but a phone an SI sent in is hers to produce. Because she sent him, the recording is hers. She quotes ONLY what is on the recording, which starts in s2b01 b5: Bhaiyaji greeting the fake inspector he was waiting for (s2b01 b10). The 10:30 invitation (s2e03 b2) was never recorded and is not quoted. The seizure memo in her hand was established in s2b02 b10 and may be mentioned if the writer has room.
key_lines: nandini: इसलिए वो recording मेरी है। बहुरूपिये की जेब का phone सबूत नहीं होता। SI का भेजा हुआ phone होता है। 'नक़ली Inspector, आप ही का इंतज़ार था': भैयाजी की आवाज़।

s2b03.what_happens: The magistrate's hand lifts one sealed envelope from the rows and turns it over. A question to the dock. Nirala answers as he answered her in s2e02.
s2b03.reveal: Two years of bribes, sealed by the man who took them, are in evidence.
key_lines: magistrate: चौबीस लिफ़ाफ़े। एक भी खोला नहीं?
nirala: Case property है, हुज़ूर।

s2b03.what_happens: The order, in the magistrate's voice, over three faces in turn: Bhaiyaji, Tripathi, then Nandini and Nirala together in one frame, stand and dock.
s2b03.reveal: Bhaiyaji and Tripathi are charged and refused bail. Nirala gets bail. On her own statement, Nandini will stand trial alongside him. Both trials are still to come (b11 says when).
key_lines: magistrate: बलराम ठाकुर, दयाशंकर त्रिपाठी: आरोप तय, bail ख़ारिज।
magistrate: सुधीर निराला: bail मंज़ूर। और SI नंदिनी जोशी: आपके अपने बयान पर, मुक़दमा आप पर भी चलेगा।

s2b03.what_happens: The room emptying. Pushpa comes to the stand with a brown envelope and says what is in it. Nandini slides the two-bar epaulettes off her shoulders and puts them in Pushpa's hand. Pushpa puts them in her cardigan pocket with the wool.
s2b03.reveal: She is suspended, on the DSP's signature. Pushpa is left in charge of the thana. (The DSP and Pushpa accounted for.)
key_lines: pushpa: Suspension order, madam। DSP साहब के sign हैं।
nandini: सँभालकर रखिए, पुष्पा जी।
pushpa: थाना मैं देख लूँगी।

s2b03.what_happens: Nirala, bare-headed, at her elbow. He asks the question the viewer has. She answers with his own rule. They both look at the brass medal on the evidence table; neither touches it.
s2b03.reveal: The cost is stated and accepted. The promise of s2b01 is half kept, in the image: he came back; the medal lies among the evidence. (Her spoken line about the medal is cut for length, D-006 change 8; see writer_notes.)
key_lines: nirala: Madam... आप झूठ बोल देतीं, तो बच जातीं।
nandini: आप ही ने सिखाया था: जो लिखो, बोलकर लिखो।

s2b03.what_happens: FINAL IMAGE, resolution, weeks later. The talkies lobby in morning light. Over the desk a new hand-painted board (painted blank; overlay). Nandini at the desk in a plain mustard kurta, pen behind her ear, the brass medal on a stack of forms as a paperweight. Nirala beside her in a white shirt, no cap, out on bail, a string of blank tokens in his hand. He says what this place is and is not, and asks her the one thing still hanging over both of them; she answers in two words and nods at the bench; he calls the first number. THE LAST EXCHANGE CARRIES THE BILL: both trials are pending, on the same day. (That FIRs are now written across the line, by Pushpa, is in the picture and the overlay only; the spoken line for it is cut.)
key_lines: nirala: ये help desk है, थाना नहीं, madam। मेरी तारीख़ अगले महीने है। आपकी?
nandini: उसी दिन। बुलाइए।
nirala: अगला! Token एक।

cliffhanger_ladder.question: Her own thana turned away all thirty complaints against Bhaiyaji. So who is she being sent to arrest tomorrow, and why did her SHO say no thirty times?
cliffhanger_ladder.spoken_by: nandini reads one refusal date aloud, names the SHO who refused it, and then asks the forward question herself: 'तो कल दस बजे से पहले... arrest किसे करूँ?' (b12).

cliffhanger_ladder.question: What is Tripathi telling Bhaiyaji about the fake thana, and what will Bhaiyaji do to the man he thinks he bought?
cliffhanger_ladder.spoken_by: tripathi, into the phone (b12). Cut before any reply.

cliffhanger_ladder.question: Does she cuff a frightened man who cannot defend himself and let a truck she cannot stop leave on her SHO's stamp, or send him in unarmed, against an order that will put her name in his FIR, to a man who may already know what he is?
The people who trusted a fake uniform will not open the door to a real one. How does she get even one signature before ten?
cliffhanger_ladder.spoken_by: door1_man, as he shuts the door (b11).

cliffhanger_ladder.question: The man named in all thirty FIRs has just arrived as the DSP's chief guest. Will the DSP take the register, or bury it and her with it?

None: resolved. Bhaiyaji and Tripathi are taken into custody on thirty FIRs, the grain is gone, Nirala leaves in the prison van the same morning to plead guilty, she stays. Last image: a salute returned through a prison-van grille, and behind her a bench full of last night's complainants.
cliffhanger_ladder.spoken_by: pushpa's last line supports the image; nothing is left to read.

cliffhanger_ladder.question: Bhaiyaji was waiting for a fake inspector. What does he want him for, and how does she reach him with no order, no backup and a dead line?
cliffhanger_ladder.spoken_by: nirala reads the SHO's signature off the slip (b9); bhaiyaji's laugh and line on the phone and nandini's 'इन्हें पता था।' (b10); then pushpa: the line is cut (b11).

cliffhanger_ladder.question: The seizure stands only while nobody asks who sent the fake inspector in. Tripathi will ask in court. What will she say?
cliffhanger_ladder.spoken_by: bhaiyaji tells tripathi whose phone was in the pocket (b11); tripathi, pointing at her, says what he will tell the court (b12).

cliffhanger_ladder.question: None: resolved. She tells the truth; Bhaiyaji and Tripathi are charged and refused bail; she is suspended and will stand trial alongside Nirala, on the same day next month. Last image: a help desk in the old talkies, and 'Token एक'.
cliffhanger_ladder.spoken_by: The last exchange carries the pending trial ('मेरी तारीख़ अगले महीने है। आपकी?' 'उसी दिन।'); nirala's last line is 'अगला! Token एक।'

ladder_check.note: No type repeats back to back on either path. Stakes rise by path position: a puzzle (1), a man in danger (2), her decision (3), the plan failing (4), the whole case and her career in one room (5), ending (6). Every non-final rung is carried by a spoken line; no ending depends on an overlay.

choice.asked_at: End of s2e03, 11 p.m., in the talkies lobby.
choice.asked_by: nandini, aloud, over Nirala's outstretched wrists.

question.hi: इन्हें हथकड़ी लगाऊँ, या आज रात Inspector बनने दूँ?
question.en: Do I cuff him, or let him be Inspector tonight?

choice.question_wording_note: D-006 change 19 amends D-004: 'इन्हें', not the earlier pronoun. She says 'ये... हैं' of him two beats earlier and 'निराला जी' and 'आप' everywhere else. The English is unchanged. app/public/media/series2/series.json must be synced from this field by the product track.

question_context.hi: आधी रात को भैयाजी ने 'Inspector साहब' को godown बुलाया है। निराला के पास सिर्फ़ लकड़ी की revolver है।
question_context.en: Bhaiyaji has called his 'Inspector' to the godown at midnight. All Nirala has is a wooden revolver.

A.gain: One thing only: Nirala is alive and in her lockup tonight, by the book. Whatever Tripathi told Bhaiyaji, it cannot reach him there, and she has obeyed her order.
A.cost: For certain, and to her: she locks up the one policeman Imlipur trusted, with her own hands, and at ten past twelve she stands at the crossing and watches eight hundred sacks of ration grain leave town knowing she let them. She says why before the vote (s2e03 b7): the SHO will stamp the slip if Nirala does not, and she cannot stop a truck that carries her own SHO's stamp. The invitation was in his name, so the one door into Bhaiyaji's godown shuts for good. Thirty complainants are left holding receipts from a thana that never existed.

B.gain: One real chance, the only one there will ever be, to catch Bhaiyaji with the grain in his godown, on evidence a fake thana spent two years collecting.
B.cost: For certain, and spoken to her before the vote (s2e03 b6): she has just been ordered to lock him up at once, and the DSP has said that any officer who helps him will be named in the same FIR. If she sends him in she breaks that order knowingly, on her own authority, with no backup, and her name goes into his case; nothing later takes this back (s2b01 b1, s2b02 b10, s2b03 b8). And she sends a frightened, unarmed man with a carved revolver, alone, to a strongman her own SHO phoned that evening. If Bhaiyaji knows, Nirala walks into it and she put him there.

choice.why_hard: The trade is one man's safety against a town's one chance, and each option's gain is the other's cost. A keeps Nirala safe and Nandini clean, and the grain leaves in front of her on a stamp she cannot challenge: the lawful choice is also the one where the thief wins tonight. B is the brave one and the exciting one, but the viewer has just heard the DSP tell her that helping him puts her name in his FIR, has heard Tripathi start that call, has heard Pushpa say it connected, and has just watched Nirala's hands shake over a piece of teak. The invitation itself settles nothing: same words as every month. A viewer who votes B is betting a likeable man's safety on a phone call nobody heard; a viewer who votes A is choosing to lose the grain to protect him. Nirala does not plead either way, so whichever it is, it is her doing.
balance_rules: The city transfer is not a reward and is not part of the choice. It is her own pending application (s2e01 b7). It is not mentioned in s2e03, on the question card, on the ballot or in either glimpse.
A's gain is not padded: no promotion, no praise, no promise that the FIR route exists (that idea is Nirala's, after the truck has gone, in s2a01).
A's cost is closed in speech before the vote: 'मोहर SHO साहब लगा देंगे, और मोहर लगा truck मैं रोक नहीं सकती' (s2e03 b7). The viewer is not left to wonder why a real SI cannot simply stop the truck.
B's danger to Nirala is on screen before the vote: Pushpa's report (s2e03 b4), the DSP's refusal (b6), the wooden revolver and his shaking hands (b8), his own words 'उनके पास असली है'.

B's cost to Nandini is spoken before the vote and never taken back: the DSP orders him locked up now and says any officer who helps him will be named in the same FIR (s2e03 b6). In s2b01 b1 she does not argue that she is inside the order; in s2b02 b10 the DSP sends a force without withdrawing it; s2b03 b8 collects it.
She reports the tip truthfully in s2e03 b6: Bhaiyaji's own voice, heard on Nirala's phone. The DSP refuses the source, not a lie.

Bhaiyaji's invitation has an ordinary reason that holds whether or not he knows: the crossing is on the outpost's side, the slip needs a stamp, the outpost is cheaper than Tripathi, and it is the same as every month (s2e03 b2). That the slip was already stamped is not known to anyone on screen until after the vote.
Nirala's revolver and wrists are played straight: frightened, formal, no comic tag, no music sting.

The pull of B is the excitement of the sting; the pull of A is Nirala's fear and her own name.

A.recut: D-006 change 4, amending D-004: cut from the FIRST HALF of s2a01 only (b1, b4, b5 and the first line of b6). Nothing from b6's second line onwards is in the glimpse.
A.shows: Four moments, in this order. (1) s2a01 b1: the ratchet of handcuffs closing on two outstretched wrists; his line 'बस... cap रहने दीजिए।' (2) s2a01 b4: the barred door of the real lockup closing on a small man in full uniform and peaked cap, sitting bolt upright. (3) s2a01 b5: the clock hands at twelve; through the bars: 'बारह। भैयाजी इंतज़ार कर रहे होंगे।' (4) s2a01 b6, first line only: the crossing, a loaded truck idling behind the gate arm; she steps into its headlights with her hand up: 'रोकिए। काग़ज़ दिखाइए।' Cut.
A.ends_on: Spoken: 'रोकिए। काग़ज़ दिखाइए।', on her raised hand in the headlights. New question: he is locked up and the truck is at the crossing; can she stop it?
A.must_not_reveal: Whether the truck passes. Who signed the slip, or that she reads it at all. 'काग़ज़ पूरे हैं।' The tail-lights and 'मैंने जाने दिया' (s2a01 b7). 'FIR लिखिए' and the ten o'clock clock (s2a01 b9). The shut door and 'असली थाने में एक बार जा चुके हैं' (s2a01 b11). That anyone signs. The handcuffed door-to-door walk. The second key and the FIR register coming out of the almirah. s2a01 b8 in any form (the inference that Bhaiyaji knew Nirala was a fake): it would settle the risk of choice B for someone who has not voted. Who signed the truck's slip. The DSP's arrival with Bhaiyaji. Any image from s2a02 or s2a03. The transfer application.

B.shows: Four moments, in this order. (1) s2b01 b3: her fingers unpinning the big brass medal from his chest: 'लौटकर ले लीजिएगा।' (2) s2b01 b4: the wooden revolver, in profile, sliding into the holster, her hand buttoning the flap: 'निकालिएगा मत।' (3) s2b01 b6: the crossing at midnight, his salute, and a small figure under a peaked cap walking alone toward the black mouth of the godown. (4) s2b01 b8: the shutter coming down behind him; a second after the rattle dies, his voice on the phone, full voice, to Bhaiyaji: 'Shutter क्यों गिरा दिया गया, भैयाजी?' Cut before any answer.
B.ends_on: Spoken: 'Shutter क्यों गिरा दिया गया, भैयाजी?' over the closed shutter. He stays in cover: no 'madam' with Bhaiyaji in the room. New question: he is shut inside with a piece of teak and a hidden phone; what is the answer?
B.must_not_reveal: That Bhaiyaji knows he is a fake: no laugh, no 'नक़ली Inspector', no 'इन्हें पता था', no dead line (s2b01 b10, b11). Bhaiyaji's answer to the shutter question. Anything else seen or heard inside the godown, including s2b01 b9 where the sting appears to be working and the slip is read out. That the slip is already signed. The danger word. Nandini entering the godown, the seizure memo, Tripathi's arrival. Any image from s2b02 or s2b03.

rules_for_both: Each glimpse makes sense without the other and without knowing which option won.
Each ends on a spoken line. No overlay carries a glimpse ending.
Neither shows its branch's loss as done: A stops before the truck passes, B stops before the trap is sprung. A viewer who watches both before voting has seen neither outcome.
S14 cuts from finished episode material; no new frames or lines are needed.

A.summary: She produces the impersonator in cuffs at the DSP's press conference, exactly as ordered, and with him thirty FIRs registered overnight in the real register, which she reads into the microphones before the DSP can cover them. He cannot bury them in front of the press, so he owns them: Bhaiyaji, his own chief guest, and Tripathi are taken into custody for extortion. The eight hundred sacks are gone for good and she says so. She takes her own transfer application back out of the DSP's file. The same morning the prison van takes Nirala away, still in his uniform and cap; he tells her he will plead guilty. No sentence is named.
A.final_image: The barred grille of a prison-van door: Nirala salutes through it, cap straight. Nothing chains her arm to his now, and she returns the salute of her own will. Behind her, through the thana doorway, the complainants' bench is occupied for the first time, by last night's complainants (three pairs of hands holding papers). It is the same morning as the press conference. Pushpa, off screen: 'Madam, bench भर गई है।'
A.lead_state: Still in uniform, staying by choice. She has learnt what the uniform is for from a man who was never allowed to wear it, and she carries the grain she let go.
A.what_it_cost: Nirala's freedom; eight hundred sacks of the town's ration; her certainty that the book and the right thing are the same.

B.summary: Bhaiyaji and Tripathi were caught in the godown with the truck on her seizure memo. At the bail hearing the defence makes the whole case about the fake inspector and offers her a free lie: say she never knew, and Nirala falls alone while she walks. She says she sent him. That truth is what makes the recording evidence: a phone in an impostor's pocket proves nothing, a phone an SI sent in is hers to produce. The case holds: Bhaiyaji and Tripathi are charged and refused bail. On her own statement she is suspended and will stand trial alongside Nirala, who gets bail. Weeks later, at the help desk, both of them have the same court date next month: the bill is still to be paid.
B.final_image: The lobby of the old talkies in morning light under a new hand-painted board (blank; overlay). Nandini in a plain mustard kurta at the desk, the brass medal on a stack of forms as a paperweight. Nirala beside her in a white shirt, no cap, calling: 'अगला! Token एक।'
B.lead_state: Out of uniform and doing the job anyway. She no longer needs the bars on her shoulder to know what she is.
B.what_it_cost: Her uniform, her record and a criminal charge; Nirala's cap and his thana; nothing is handed back.

endings.neither_refunds_the_other: A viewer who has seen both can still argue either way: A keeps her in the job with the town's trust and loses the grain and Nirala's freedom; B wins the grain and both men in custody and costs her the uniform.

production_locks.uniform: The approved proof force (content/proof/flat2d/style.json): sandy khaki shirt and trousers, dark teal epaulettes with off-white bars, a white lantern on a round teal patch on each upper sleeve. NO CAPS and NO STARS anywhere in the real force. Rank by bars: Head Constable one (pushpa), Sub-Inspector two (nandini), Inspector three (tripathi; nirala copies it). The DSP wears one broad off-white band. The one-bar, three-bar and broad-band marks are this bible's extension of the proof scheme (which fixed only two bars and none); S6 may redraw them but may not use stars or any real insignia.
production_locks.nirala_reads_in_silhouette: Never by counting bars. He is the only peaked cap in the series; his uniform is one size too big; his one thing too many is the single large home-made brass medal.
production_locks.hook_image: s2e01 b1: a khaki sleeve with the lantern patch holding the cardboard token. No stars in the hook. In s2b01 and Glimpse B she unpins the medal.
production_locks.wooden_revolver: Holstered, lying on a desk or on the weighing scale, or held in profile (including butt-first in s2b02 b11). Never pointed at a face or at the camera. No other weapon appears in the series.
production_locks.text: All readable text is an assembly overlay. Boards, papers, tokens, tags, slips, the shield plate, banners and phone screens are painted blank. Clocks are painted with hands and no numerals. Every overlay is listed under 'overlays'. Nothing the plot needs depends on reading one: each has a spoken line that carries the same fact.
production_locks.plates: Seven: real_thana, talkies_lobby, projection_room, crossing_stall, godown, lane_doorway, magistrate_room. The press conference is staged in real_thana as a table of microphones with no audience. The prison van and the DSP's car are close inserts. One truck design.
production_locks.sheets: Six: nandini, nirala, tripathi, bhaiyaji, pushpa, dsp. Two of them need a second-period drawing: nandini (mustard kurta, s2b03 final image) and nirala (bare-headed in court and in a white shirt, s2b03). Nirala also has a period 1b in branch B (s2b01 b2 to the end of s2b02: no medal, cuffs folded back, belt tail tucked, shoulder seams squared); S6 decides whether that needs its own drawing or can be prompted from the period 1 sheet.
production_locks.faces_without_sheets: Three, in branch A only, one shot each, never recurring: door1_man (s2a01), door2_woman and door3_man (s2a02). The magistrate and the defence lawyer are voices with hands or a back. No children. No crowd: groups are shown as objects (thirty thumbprints, twenty-four envelopes, three pairs of hands, a table of microphones).
production_locks.stills_only: Every beat is written as one or two readable stills: hands, objects, faces, silhouettes. Movement that cannot be a still (a truck leaving, a shutter falling, a salute) is one frame plus sound. The cuffed walk in s2a02 is a series of fixed images, not choreography.
production_locks.screen_sides_for_the_chain: s2a02: Nirala's RIGHT wrist is cuffed to Nandini's LEFT wrist, so in a front two-shot she stands picture-left and he picture-right with the chain between them. She writes with her right hand; he holds the ink pad in his left.

If the critic finds it flat, strengthen these images; do not add a chase or a fight.
